title: Main landmark in AppShellLayout, one selectable opt-out class

entries.note: `AppShellLayout` renders its content region as `<main id="main" tabindex="-1">`. A page that already wraps its content in `<main>` now has two landmarks: remove yours or pass `mainId={null}` (the region becomes a plain div).

`nativeFeel()` has one opt-out class for the context menu and text selection. `.selectable` only existed in a JSDoc line; until it is renamed, right-click on that region is blocked. The codemod renames `class="selectable"` and `class:selectable` in markup.
